scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run test:memory-core && npm run test:auth && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:server && npm run test:dashboard && npm run eval:memory && npm run bench:memory && npm run bench:longmemeval:tiny && npm run e2e:cross-host && npm run check:markdown-links && npm run check:tracked-secrets
scripts.test: npm run test:memory-core && npm run test:auth && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:server && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.test:postgres:integration: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node --test test-integration/postgres-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:postgres:restart: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node scripts/db/postgres-restart-test.mjs
scripts.test:onboarding: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node --test test/onboarding-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:server: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:server -- --noEmit
scripts.dashboard:build: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/dashboard
scripts.demo:cross-host: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node scripts/e2e/cross-host-demo.mjs
scripts.bench:memory: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && HANDOFFBASE_BENCH_SKIP_BUILD=1 node scripts/run-memory-benchmarks.mjs
scripts.bench:longmemeval: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node scripts/benchmarks/longmemeval-run.mjs
scripts.bench:longmemeval:tiny: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node scripts/benchmarks/longmemeval-tiny.mjs
scripts.bench:longmemeval:compare: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node scripts/benchmarks/longmemeval-compare.mjs
scripts.e2e:cross-host: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node --test test/e2e/cross-host-http.test.mjs
scripts.mcp:validate-remote: npm run build --workspace @handoffbase/memory-core && npm run build:server && node scripts/validate-remote-mcp.mjs
